verdict.rationale: Fireflies' notetaker (fred@fireflies.ai) can be invited to a live meeting or auto-join calendar meetings to record and transcribe, and Google Meet recording is named explicitly. Admin rules give some control over meeting access, which only loosely covers choosing where recording happens. Zoom and Microsoft Teams are never named, and an older community comment says capture was audio-only rather than video. Missing for 10: explicit Zoom and Teams support, documented per-meeting or per-calendar recording controls, independent evidence of capture reliability, and current evidence of video recording.
